classification_rationale: The Gate 1 Resource Ledger is required on every C++ diff and the range had no governance.d fragment (the Gate 3 policy floor, G-1); this row records the ledger and is the fix for that floor.
summary: Gate 1 Resource Ledger (C++) for b7a9905e6..18454fec2 plus the G-2 fix: no new or modified owning raw resource; value-type state only (cursor_retry_ under collect_mu_, touched by the cursor loop in collect_slow_impl and erased at a cursor source's enable/disable edge in do_configure; next_retry_ under health_mu_; commit_failing_since_ in RegistryCursorSource::collect); no thread, handle, callback, subprocess or manual cleanup. The ledger text is in the sibling .resource-ledger.md.

trigger: a source is disabled and re-enabled between two slow ticks while it is in backoff
classification_rationale: docs/user-manual/echo.md and docs/echo-implementer.md promise that disabling or re-enabling a source ends its backoff; the code erased the record only in the collect-time disabled branch, so a pause shorter than one slow tick kept it.
summary: Pause and re-enable between two slow ticks kept the old backoff and its next-retry line: the only erase was the collect-time disabled branch (echo_plugin.cpp:2686-2687); the configure edge only routed on_enabled_changed (~4393-4420). Bounded delay (at most 12 ticks), no loss. Also raised as CX-1 by the Codex adversarial pass. Fixed in the PR: do_configure erases cursor_retry_ and clears the next-retry line inside the cursor-edge try, before on_enabled_changed, under the collect_mu_ already held (order collect_mu_ -> health_mu_, as the collect loop); gated on transition_ok && edge, so an idempotent re-assert or a failed transition clears nothing. No executing regression test is possible (echo_plugin.cpp is not in yuzu_echo_tests, see G-4); the edge is read-verified and named in the PR-body disclosure.

trigger: a backed-off power or removable source accumulates more than 4096 queued events, or its OS log wraps, before the next attempt
classification_rationale: The manual's 'lose nothing while backed off' contradicts BoundedPendingQueue (kCap 4096, drop-oldest, counted) and echo_cursor.hpp rule 2 (a wrapped log is CursorLost plus a capture_gap).
summary: 'Power and removable lose nothing while backed off' is false for the 4096-entry BoundedPendingQueue (drop-oldest, counted as a dropped total and reported as a gap) and for a wrapped log; a longer wait widens the exposure. Also raised as CX-2. The same claim sat in docs/echo-implementer.md, which the finding did not cite. Fixed in both docs: a backed-off source is normally only late by at most one backoff interval, the two limits are named, and both are recorded as a capture_gap row on the next tick that completes. Band: I4 (harmful operator guidance) was considered and not applied, because the sentence directs no named action and the loss is counted and gap-reported, so nothing is concealed; I7 gives the ruled MEDIUM.

trigger: a later change to the driver loop in collect_slow_impl regresses the gate order, a back_off site or the note_success placement
classification_rationale: A test of the driver wiring is missing; no shipped doc claim is contradicted.
summary: The driver backoff wiring in echo_plugin.cpp has no executing test: EchoPlugin is translation-unit-local and echo_plugin.cpp is not a source of yuzu_echo_tests (tests/meson.build:1383). Also raised as FN-codex-1 (HIGH as filed by Codex, downgraded to MEDIUM by the code-review adjudication); the executing test it asks for needs the plugin seam tracked by #6897. The pure policy the driver calls is executed (CursorRetry and parse_tick_seconds in test_echo_cursor.cpp, the ledger line in test_echo_source_health.cpp, the registry stall row in test_echo_registry_source.cpp). Read-verified and disclosed in the PR body: the driver order (enable gate, due check, cursor read, collect), the four back_off sites, note_success directly after collect() returns, and the configure-edge clear added for G-2. The cursor-driver cases (governance CH-1 and CH-2) are to be added to #6897 by the orchestrator's batched issue comment, or a new issue filed if #6897's scope does not fit.

trigger: the stall row is pushed after, or outside, the atomic event+cursor commit and the test still passes
classification_rationale: The warehouse-side assertion that the stall row is kept is missing; no shipped doc claim is contradicted.
summary: The commit_stalled assertions read observer rows (ql() rebuilds its table from committed_rows), not what the database kept, so durable atomicity of the stall row was unasserted. Also raised as FN-codex-2 (HIGH as filed, downgraded to MEDIUM). Fixed: the case now takes count_rows(t.db) (SUM(change_count) over registry_hourly) after the baseline tick and checks it is unchanged after the three trapped ticks, kept + 2 after the recovery tick (the loss row and the stall row, one commit) and still kept + 2 after a later tick.

trigger: an operator runs collect_slow or snapshot by hand against a backed-off source expecting a retry
classification_rationale: The manual does not say a manual collect is throttled too; the behaviour itself is intended and no doc claim is contradicted.
summary: A manual collect_slow or snapshot goes through collect_slow_impl, so it cannot force a retry of a backed-off source; snapshot reports the source skipped (partial). Raised as a Spec question by the code-review pass and as G-6: intended? Ruled intended: the plugin cannot tell an operator's collect_slow from the scheduled one, and a bypass would add a force parameter through wiring no test compiles to save at most 12 ticks. Fixed by documenting it in docs/user-manual/echo.md (facts only, no recommended workaround).

trigger: a commit fails, the agent restarts, and the source then commits
classification_rationale: An optional test is missing; the restart behaviour is documented and no doc claim is contradicted.
summary: A restart during a commit failure is not exercised by a test (also FN-codex-3). Rejected: commit_failing_since_ is a plain in-memory std::optional member that a new RegistryCursorSource starts with empty (echo_registry_source.hpp), and the case 'a commit that never failed records no commit stalled gap' already pins what a fresh, restarted source does on its first commit (no stall row). The no-row-after-restart behaviour is documented in the manual and the implementer doc.

classification_rationale: An over-engineering finding (duplicate test code); no doc claim is contradicted.
summary: Ponytail-review found 27 lines that could go, in four trims. Taken: the case 'a success after failures makes the source due at once and forgets the first failure time' in test_echo_cursor.cpp is deleted and its two unique assertions (first_failure_ts is 0 after note_success and 200 after the fresh note_failure) are folded into 'one success clears the backoff'; no assertion is lost. Rejected (three): one set_next_retry taking an optional (the branch is relocated, not removed, and test_echo_source_health.cpp pins the current API); deleting the 'clearing the next retry' health test (it is the only executing check that the line disappears on recovery, since clear_next_retry's sole production caller is in echo_plugin.cpp, which no test compiles); capping `failures` at 5 (zero lines saved by the finding's own account, and it would repeat the literal 5 next to kMaxTicks).

trigger: the registry test Fake changes its per-read clock step
classification_rationale: A test-style nit about a hard-coded constant; nothing shipped is contradicted.
summary: The commit_stalled case writes `first_failure = f.clock + 1000`, hard-coding the fake clock's per-read step. Rejected: the step is the Fake's own documented constant (`r.now_ts = [this] { return clock += 1000; }; // strictly increasing`, test_echo_registry_source.cpp:1579) and the same literal is already used the same way at :1699; a Fake change would fail this case loudly, not silently.

classification_rationale: A formatting nit about continuation-line indentation; nothing shipped is contradicted.
summary: The `registry_gap_row(` continuation lines are indented three spaces. Rejected: formatting only, and no formatter gate runs in CI (the clang-format job is disabled, .github/workflows/ci.yml:714).
